calls.statement:
SELECT 
  s.store_name,
  s.store_id,
  p.category,
  p.subcategory,
  rfc.fiscal_year,
  rfc.fiscal_period,
  SUM(f.quantity) as total_units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar rfc ON f.sale_date BETWEEN rfc.period_start_date AND rfc.period_end_date
WHERE s.store_id = 108  -- Lahti store
  AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
  AND rfc.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND rfc.fiscal_period = 3
  AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
GROUP BY s.store_name, s.store_id, p.category, p.subcategory, rfc.fiscal_year, rfc.fiscal_period
calls.output_preview:

(1 row)

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  f.staff_purchase_flag,
  SUM(f.quantity) as quantity
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar rfc ON f.sale_date BETWEEN rfc.period_start_date AND rfc.period_end_date
WHERE s.store_id = 108  -- Lahti store
  AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
  AND rfc.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND rfc.fiscal_period = 3
GROUP BY f.staff_purchase_flag

SELECT 
  MIN(f.sale_date) as first_sale_date,
  MAX(f.sale_date) as last_sale_date,
  COUNT(*) as transaction_count
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar rfc ON f.sale_date BETWEEN rfc.period_start_date AND rfc.period_end_date
WHERE s.store_id = 108  -- Lahti store
  AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
  AND rfc.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND rfc.fiscal_period = 3
  AND f.staff_purchase_flag = FALSE
